title: specification PPA targets (Design/specification/ppa.json)
description: The PPA gate targets specification emits into the ppa.json sidecar (one object per gated dimension; [] when none). synthesis and power-analysis read this file directly as their acceptance standard; rtl-design receives it via the Orchestrator-authored directive. The dim enum is the cross-stage PPA namespace every downstream ppa_actual[].dim must be a subset of.
